gold: Complete spinal cord injury (SCI) at C4-C5 level with intramedullary hemorrhage

selector.rationale: The patient's symptoms of quadriplegia, urinary and stool incontinence, and the MRI findings of spinal cord compression and reduced diffusion in the spinal cord white matter support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Hypothermia
rejected.why: Although the patient has hypothermia, it is not the primary diagnosis explaining the neurological findings.

rejected.label: Acute transverse myelitis
rejected.why: The presence of spinal cord compression and ligament disruptions on MRI suggests a traumatic injury rather than an inflammatory process like myelitis.

rejected.label: Traumatic Spondylolisthesis
rejected.why: While there is evidence of spondylolisthesis, the primary diagnosis is the acute spinal cord injury resulting from the trauma.
